title: UL-03 — Challenge: IAM role, resource policy, and STS
scenario: Design a least-privilege reader role for one bucket, enable GuardDuty long enough to capture pricing, then disable it. Tighten policies beyond GL-03.
acceptanceCriteria: IAM policy on the lab role lists only the lab bucket Arn and object prefix, not `*`.
Trust policy allows assume-role only for your lab IAM principal, not `*`.
GuardDuty detector is enabled and you record the per-feature monthly estimate from official pricing.
GuardDuty is disabled or suspended before teardown.
Assume-role session can list and get objects but cannot put or delete.
Bucket policy does not grant public access.
STS session credentials expire and you cleared them from the shell.
CloudTrail is not required but if enabled for test, it is removed in teardown.
No access keys were created for the lab role.
Teardown removes GuardDuty before IAM and S3.
Teardown deletes role inline policies then role.
Teardown empties and deletes the bucket.

hints.text: Scope Resource ARNs to bucket and objects.
GuardDuty has a free trial then per-event pricing; disable when done.
Delete role policies before deleting the role.

solution.outline: GuardDuty priced and disabled; scoped IAM; full teardown.

stopChargesPanel: Disable GuardDuty, delete IAM role and bucket resources tagged ul-03.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-03 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl03-role returns NoSuchEntity
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-03 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-03 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-03. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-03) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
